description: Look up a compound by name or identifier and get its chemical structure representations — SMILES (isomeric + canonical), InChI, InChIKey, molecular formula, and molecular weight. Convert between chemical identifier formats (PubChem / NCBI)

name.description: Compound name or identifier (e.g. "caffeine", "50-78-2") — returns SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, formula

name: chemistry.pubchem.structure

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Chemical Structure Lookup
